Every quarter brought new semiconductor restrictions, naval jockeying in the South China Sea or retaliatory tariffs, locking the world’s two preeminent powers in an apparently irreversible downward spiral. articles.summary: The FlyDubai flight incident briefly raised concerns about a possible hijacking and prompted Israel to scramble warplanes; Israeli media, citing security officials, said it was a feud between the plane's two pilots, and everyone on board was safe Israel-bound commercial plane from Dubai diverted to Saudi Arabia after distress call.

articles.title: Malaysia begins Myanmar repatriations despite warnings from UN and rights groups
articles.summary: Kuala Lumpur plans to send a total of 5,000 Myanmar nationals back to the war-torn country despite persecution concerns Malaysia began sending back about 1,500 Myanmar nationals on Tuesday, the government confirmed, as it launched a scheme that rights groups say may endanger migrants and asylum seekers by returning them to the war-torn country. Malaysia begins Myanmar repatriations despite warnings from UN and rights groups.

articles.title: Iran Threatens Energy Sites, Pens Letter To US Voters As It Awaits Official Response To Plan
articles.summary: Iran threatened to attack energy infrastructure across the Middle East if its security isn't guaranteed as it ratcheted up its rhetoric while waiting for the United States to officially respond to a plan Tehran says would reopen the Strait of Hormuz. Iran Threatens Energy Sites, Pens Letter To US Voters As It Awaits Official Response To Plan.

articles.title: DRC peace deals fail to halt fighting as Ebola deepens crisis
articles.summary: The Security Council is meeting in New York on the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) Tuesday, where clashes between Government forces and M23 rebels continue in the east despite a series of peace agreements. Ambassadors are likely to focus on ceasefire monitoring, rising tensions between the DRC and Rwanda, and the country’s worst Ebola outbreak on record. DRC peace deals fail to halt fighting as Ebola deepens crisis.

articles.title: Bangladesh energy crisis calls for pragmatism, not political purity
articles.summary: For more than three decades, the Bangladeshi political left has maintained an unyielding stance on natural resources like gas, coal, and minerals, insisting that state entities must develop them exclusively. Foreign energy companies are viewed with deep suspicion, while production-sharing contracts are routinely condemned as vehicles designed to siphon national wealth to foreign multinationals. Co Bangladesh energy crisis calls for pragmatism, not political purity.

articles.title: As Russia Targets Civilians, Pressure Mounts On Trump To Use Sanctions Powers
articles.summary: A new wave of deadly Russian attacks on Ukrainian cities is fueling bipartisan calls in Washington for US President Donald Trump to use sweeping new sanctions powers against Moscow, with lawmakers arguing that greater economic pressure could strengthen efforts to end the war. As Russia Targets Civilians, Pressure Mounts On Trump To Use Sanctions Powers.

articles.title: China’s disputed satellite refueling heralds new space war era
articles.summary: Recent disclosures about China’s purported in-orbit servicing operations have intensified a quiet revolution in space, where the mechanics of satellite sustainment are swiftly becoming the frontline of great-power counterspace rivalry. This month, the South China Morning Post (SCMP) reported that Chinese researchers claim the country carried out a pioneering in-orbit refueling operation on a high- China’s disputed satellite refueling heralds new space war era.

articles.title: Volkswagen-Gotion deal shows hard limits of China de-risking
articles.summary: Volkswagen has spent years trying to build a European battery business strong enough to carry its electric-car ambitions. Its latest deal pulls a Chinese partner deeper into that effort. On September 28, Germany’s Volkswagen and China’s Gotion High-Tech agreed to deepen a partnership that began in 2020. articles.title: Zelenskyy Warns Of New Russian Mobilization, 10,000 North Korean Troop Deployment
articles.summary: The death toll from Russia’s jet-powered drone attacks mounted in Ukraine while Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy warned that the Kremlin is preparing for a new mobilization at home and a fresh deployment of 10,000 North Korean troops. Zelenskyy Warns Of New Russian Mobilization, 10,000 North Korean Troop Deployment.

articles.title: Deadly Russian Attacks On Ukraine Hit Medical Center, Science Academy
articles.summary: Russian forces struck civilian sites on 28 September, setting fire to the National Academy of Sciences and a major medical clinic in Kyiv. An office building in Dnipro and an apartment block in Kharkiv also suffered damage. The attacks caused casualties and disrupted services. A wave of Russian attacks hit civilian sites in several Ukrainian cities on September 28. In Kyiv, fire broke out after strikes on the National Academy of Sciences and a major medical clinic.

articles.title: Russian Mockery Of UN Meeting Shows It's Not Interested In Ending Ukraine War
articles.summary: European Union foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas said on September 28 that Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov's treatment of his German counterpart, Johann Wadephul, after their recent UN meeting demonstrates that Russia is not interested in peace in Ukraine. Kallas Says Russia's Mockery Of UN Meeting Shows It's Not Interested In Ending Ukraine War. Russian Mockery Of UN Meeting Shows It's Not Interested In Ending Ukraine War.

articles.title: General Debate ends with call to turn words into action
articles.summary: After six days of speeches from the UN General Assembly podium, one word rose above all others: peace. This final edition of The Takeaway distils the messages he said reverberated through the Assembly Hall and looks at where the 193-member body goes from here. General Debate ends with call to turn words into action.

articles.title: UN leaders renew push to defeat racism, 25 years after Durban
articles.summary: “No country is free of racism.” That warning from US youth activist Marley Dias set the tone on Monday as UN Member States reinvigorated global efforts against racism, discrimination and xenophobia with a new declaration. UN leaders renew push to defeat racism, 25 years after Durban.

articles.title: DPR Korea tells UN its nuclear status is ‘irreversible’, rejects outside pressure
articles.summary: The Democratic People’s Republic of Korea (DPRK) told the UN General Assembly on Monday that its status as a nuclear-armed State was irreversible, arguing that its military capabilities were necessary to safeguard the country’s sovereignty and maintain peace on the Korean Peninsula. DPR Korea tells UN its nuclear status is ‘irreversible’, rejects outside pressure.

articles.title: Refugee funding, US migration policy triggers ‘cascade’ of rights violations, world forests report
articles.summary: Support for water and sanitation at the biggest camp in the world for Syrian refugees is under threat from a lack of funding – combined with the impact of climate change – the UN Children’s Fund, UNICEF, said on Monday. Refugee funding, US migration policy triggers ‘cascade’ of rights violations, world forests report.

articles.title: Ambassadors meet as West Bank tensions rise, Gaza plan stalls
articles.summary: The Security Council met Monday morning with prospects for peace in the Middle East under strain on two fronts. In the West Bank, settler violence and settlement expansion are raising fears for a two-State solution. In Gaza, a year-old peace plan has stalled while civilian suffering continues. The meeting comes as the plan’s remaining phases, including Hamas’ disarmament and Israel’s full withdraw.

articles.title: Hurricane Nolo still threatens Hawaii as Mexico’s Baja braces for Hurricane Polo
articles.summary: Hurricane Nolo is moving away from Hawaiian islands but threat of heavy rain, flash floods and strong winds persistsHurricane Nolo was moving away from the Hawaiian islands on Sunday, but the threat of heavy rain, flash flooding and strong winds persisted in areas of the island chain still recovering from previous storms. Hurricane Nolo still threatens Hawaii as Mexico's Baja braces for major Hurricane Polo.

articles.title: Arresting the Dangerous Descent Back into War in Northern Ethiopia
articles.summary: Long-simmering tensions have turned to large-scale fighting after armed opposition groups in Tigray, Amhara and Afar launched a multi-pronged offensive against Ethiopian government forces. It is not too late to avert a return to costly, bloody war. Arresting the Dangerous Descent Back into War in Northern Ethiopia.

articles.summary: दुबई से तेल अवीव जा रही एक फ्लाइट ने सऊदी अरब के ऊपर से वापसी की है. फ्लाइट ने हाइजैकिंग की कोशिश से जुड़ा मामला सामने आया है. इमरजेंसी कोड जारी किया और डिस्ट्रेस सिग्नल भेजा. इस मुद्दे को लेकर इजरायल के पीएम नेतन्याहू और इजरायल के रक्षा मंत्री ने इमरजेंसी बैठक बुलाई है. बताया जा रहा है कि FZ1073 ने 7700 (सामान्य आपातकाल) का सिग्नल दिया, लेकिन कुछ देर बाद इसे 7500 (गैर-कानूनी दखल) में बदल दिया.

articles.title: मोदी कैबिनेट देने जा रही किसानों को बड़ा तोहफा, बढ़ेगी इन 6 फसलों पर MSP
articles.summary: केंद्र सरकार किसानों को बड़ा तोहफा देने जा रही है. मोदी कैबिनेट की बुधवार (30 सितंबर) को होने वाली बैठक में किसानों के लिए बड़ा ऐलान हो सकता है. सूत्रों से मिली जानकारी के मुताबिक कैबिनेट की बैठक में आज रबी फसलों की MSP बढ़ाने पर मुहर लग सकती है. कैबिनेट बैठक में गेहूं, चना, सरसों, जौ समेत 6 रबी फसलों की MSP बढ़ाने पर आज मुहर लग सकती है.

articles.summary: यूपी विधानसभा चुनाव 2027 को लेकर तैयारियां तेज हो गई हैं. सभी पार्टियों ने अभी से अपनी कमर कसनी शुरू कर दी है. इसी के मद्देनजर यूपी में इंडिया गठबंधन (सपा-कांग्रेस) को लेकर बीजेपी हमलावर है. बैठक में समाजवादी पार्टी के शामिल न होने को लेकर बीजेपी प्रवक्ता प्रदीप भंडारी ने तंज कसा है.

articles.title: इंडिया गठबंधन की बैठक में कौन कौन हुआ शामिल? कांग्रेस ने दी पूरी लिस्ट
articles.summary: विपक्ष के INDIA गठबंधन की बैठक शुरू हो गई है. चुनाव आयुक्त ज्ञानेश कुमार और एसआईआर को छिड़े विवाद के बाद गठबंधन की बैठकें हो रही हैं. इसके एजेंडे में चुनाव आयोग और उससे जुड़े विवाद हैं. चुनाव आयुक्त ज्ञानेश कुमार के इस्तीफे की मांग उठ रही है. इसी बीच कांग्रेस नेता ने पोस्ट शेयर करके बताया है कि INDIA गठबंधन की बैठक में कौन-कौन सी पार्टी शामिल हुई हैं.
